name: hq
description: Keshav's harness: brain (registry, context, guards, routing), researcher and builder agents, traces.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Project registry and tracker context, guards, model routing (main loop Opus, subagents Sonnet), lazy MCP, STE output style.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: Research and architecture agent: official docs, reference systems, papers, validated architecture with diagrams, epics and tickets on a GitHub Project.

plugins.name: builder
plugins.description: Builder agent: one epic at a time from the tracker and arch docs, with fetcher, brancher, editor, code-reviewer, runner, warden and verifier subagents.

plugins.name: observe
plugins.description: Tool and subagent traces for later analysis.

plugins.name: time
plugins.description: Status band above the prompt: clock, today's and all-time tokens and cost, context use, rate limits.

plugins.name: gimme-job
plugins.description: Job hunt loop: 145 in-house scanners + Composio job APIs + Gmail alerts, A-H ranking, gap analysis, versioned resume rewrites with a fact gate, blind-judge loop to 8.5+.
